secondary_axis: C (AMPK/energy-stress aneuploid-cell vulnerability, analogous to AICAR)

approval.note: Approved biguanide (RIOMET oral solution label queried for clean single-agent pediatric text). Boxed warning: lactic acidosis.

claims.text: Metformin suppresses the senescence-associated secretory phenotype by interfering with IKK/NF-kB activation - a senomorphic action on the same paracrine-damage axis the MVA phenotype likely involves (p16-driven senescence in BubR1 insufficiency).

Aneuploidy-selective vulnerability rationale: energy-stress induction selectively kills aneuploid cells - the AMPK activator AICAR induced p53-mediated apoptosis in trisomic MEFs. Metformin activates AMPK by a different route (complex I inhibition); whether clinical metformin exposure reproduces AICAR-class aneuploidy selectivity is unproven.

Important counter-evidence: at 1-16 mM in vitro (well above clinical plasma exposure of roughly 10-40 uM), metformin induced micronuclei/nucleoplasmic bridges and DEREGULATED BUBR1 and MAD2 expression - i.e. high-dose metformin can itself impair the spindle checkpoint. Dose window matters; any benefit must be shown at exposures that do not worsen missegregation.

Population-level associations between metformin use and reduced cancer incidence are widely reported but confounded (indication, immortal-time bias); no randomised cancer-prevention evidence exists in non-diabetic children.
claims.note: Lyu et al. cite the epidemiological anticancer association in their motivation; we flag it as hypothesis-level only.

pediatric.label_source: openFDA drug/label set_id 05d4df4b-dfe8-4828-b423-a3d4f2c4114a (effective 2018-12-06); RIOMET (metformin HCl oral solution)
pediatric.boxed_warning: LACTIC ACIDOSIS: postmarketing cases have resulted in death, hypothermia, hypotension and resistant bradyarrhythmias; risk factors include renal impairment, contrast studies, surgery, hypoxic states, hepatic impairment. Contraindicated at eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73m2; not recommended at eGFR 30-45.
pediatric.approved_pediatric_indication: Type 2 diabetes mellitus in pediatric patients 10 years of age and older (10-16 studied); safety/effectiveness not established below 10 years (quoted label fact).
pediatric.label_pediatric_dosing_fact: Pediatric (>=10y) start 500 mg twice daily with meals, titrate weekly to max 2,000 mg/day (quoted label fact, not advice).
key_risks: Lactic-acidosis boxed warning: nephrocalcinosis in the HPO profile makes renal function the gating safety question; label mandates eGFR assessment before and during use and discontinuation below eGFR 30.
Vitamin B12 lowering (label 5.2): chronic B12 deficiency risk is relevant in a failure-to-thrive child with already-marginal nutrition/growth.
Hypoglycaemia when combined with insulin/secretagogues (less relevant here); GI intolerance affecting nutrition.
Theoretical: supratherapeutic-exposure SAC/genotoxic effects (claim c3) argue for exposure-level caution in a chromosome-instability syndrome.
monitoring: eGFR/renal function before and during treatment (boxed warning; nephrocalcinosis phenotype)
Vitamin B12 at 2-3 year intervals (label advice)
Hold for iodinated contrast procedures and intercurrent hypoxic/dehydrating illness (label advice)
Growth/nutrition tracking given B12 and GI effects

celegans.assay: san-1 mutant growth/lifespan rescue at graded doses
celegans.readout: viability, growth rate, him rate, lifespan
celegans.expected: possible mild benefit via AMPK/stress pathways; high doses expected toxic

fibroblasts.assay: clinical-range metformin exposure on MVA patient fibroblasts
fibroblasts.readout: SASP cytokines, aneuploidy rate (FISH/scDNA-seq), micronuclei, p-AMPK biomarker
fibroblasts.expected: SASP suppression at clinical-range exposure; go/no-go = no increase in micronuclei/aneuploidy at the tested range (per c3)

verdict_reason: Cheapest, safest-on-paper senomorphic with a pediatric label (T2DM >=10y) and plausible SASP-suppressing mechanism (PMID:23521863), plus an energy-stress analogy to AICAR's aneuploidy selectivity (PMID:21315436). Held back from top rank by two honest weaknesses: the aneuploidy-selective effect is demonstrated for AICAR/17-AAG/chloroquine, not metformin itself (analogy only), and high-dose metformin can itself deregulate BUBR1/MAD2 and induce micronuclei in vitro (PMID:35568294) - in an MVA child the dose window between senomorphic benefit and checkpoint harm is the experiment, not a given. Renal function (nephrocalcinosis) is the gating safety check.
